grades.MEASURED: read out of the ROM, the corpus, or an archived capture

coefficient_scale_warning: The reverb bank is NOT read at one uniform Q, and the two readings in circulation differ by exactly 2x. (1) The nine diffuser gains must be Q0.23 (cell/2**23): read that way 0 of 108 (12 presets x 9 stages) have |g| >= 1; read at Q1.22 (cell/2**22) 85 of 108 do, and a single-multiplier all-pass or comb stage with |g| >= 1 is unstable. (2) The DECAY cell 0x97 must be Q1.22: the firmware explicitly divides the gain by 2 before storing it (evaluator 0x039D98), so the gain the designer intends is 2 x cell/2**23. (3) The shipped MAME device applies ONE global shift, P_SHIFT + ACC_SHIFT = 22, i.e. Q1.22 everywhere -- which makes ROOM REVERB 1's first diffuser gain 1.50. (4) Register sect 227 sect 5 and any brief quoting it ('CONCERT 1.200/1.000/1.000, ROOM 1.000/0.800/1.000') are reading cells 0x9B/0x9C/0x9D at Q1.22; at Q0.23 those same three cells are 0.600/0.500/0.500 and 0.500/0.400/0.500 and they are, respectively, diffuser ladder-0 stage 4, diffuser ladder-0 stage 5 and separator-1's DRAM tap gain.

topology_verdict.identified: input mix -> damping filter -> a chain of 11 delay-line stages (9 BLOCK A + 2 BLOCK B) laid out B A^5 B A^4 B C C -> two mirrored 3-tap early-reflection output mixers. Every stage owns exactly one delay-DRAM write and one read.
topology_verdict.grade: MEASURED at the PORT level (which word touches which line at what offset). The per-stage TRANSFER FUNCTION is OPEN.
topology_verdict.comb_vs_allpass: CONSISTENT with a comb family (pipe-comb / series comb cascade), NOT FORCED. First-order all-pass, parallel comb bank, Moorer, nested all-pass and Gray-Markel lattice all score 0 -- in the topology-NEUTRAL pool as well. BUT every survivor sits at the blocking read, which the output tail falsifies 24/24 vs 0/24, and in the required read regime the search returns 0 of 400.
topology_verdict.early_reflections: YES, MEASURED: six taps (three per channel) off ONE buffer, plus the pre-delay tap off the same buffer. Cross-channel ratio cell0x18/cell0x1B = 1.2006 +- 0.0032 over twelve independently canned presets -- one design quantity, the L/R decorrelation.
topology_verdict.diffusion_network: NOT identified as such. What is measured is a SERIES chain of 11 lines whose reads run two stages upstream of their writes; that is a recirculating network, but no reference topology survives in the admissible read regime.
topology_verdict.biquad_9_word_splice: ABSENT from this image. The 9-word biquad splice unit documented for PARAMETRIC EQ (lo12 0x1D3) occurs 0 times in algo 16. The reverb's three damping units are a DIFFERENT, 4-word / 3-coefficient shape (1D5 / 415 / 1D5 / 407).

decay_path.law_grade: PROVEN BY CONSTRUCTION (evaluator 0x039D98, constants 0x012E07..0x012F03, softfloat pow at 0x03D533) + MEASURED (the live runtime poke 0xE8F713 is reproduced EXACTLY, all 24 bits, for CONCERT REVERB 1 at REVERB TIME = 2.000 s; 1 hit in 1600 candidates)
decay_path.T60_status: NOT ESTABLISHED. The single-comb identity T60 = 3D / (-log10 g) does not recover any measured line length: DARK 1, DARK 2 and BRIGHT 1 carry the SAME K over tanks that differ by 25 %, so K is not a loop length. The gain is known; the loop it closes is not, because the stage transfer function is open (ALU_OPEN). This project has guessed this quantity wrong three times; it is left OPEN here.

REVERB DECAY / LOOP GAIN -- C[0x97]
boot bank +0.200 (Q0.23); RUNTIME poke -0.17996 -> chip gain -2*cell = -0.400
nodes.evidence: w17 = 000.A.0A.1D5 at cursor 0x97. The firmware COMPUTES this cell: UI slot 0 'REVERB TIME (s)' -> level-2 op 0x75 -> evaluator 0x039D98 -> writer 0x0387E6 -> C-RAM 0x97, with cell = int(-(10**(-4.816*K/T))/2 * 2**23). dsp/tools/reverb_time.py solves T back to the discrete UI list for 12 of 12 presets, none missing by >2 %; the live capture's runtime poke '0A 74 7B 89 A6' decodes to 0xE8F713 = -0.17996, EXACT for CONCERT REVERB 1 at REVERB TIME = 2.000 s (register sect 72)
nodes.caveat: MEASURED SIGN DISAGREEMENT: the canned boot bulk load writes the cell POSITIVE (+0.200 ROOM 1 / +0.180 CONCERT 1) and the runtime refresh writes it NEGATIVE (-0.180). Both are in the SAME archived capture (transfer 25 vs transfer 26). Which sign the tank runs on is therefore a function of whether any parameter has been refreshed since boot

nodes.label:
UNDECODED: WHAT THE 6-WORD CORE COMPUTES
Two rival readings, and they are NOT reconciled:
 (a) r1-allpass-motif (2026-07-26): a software-pipelined ONE-MULTIPLIER ALL-PASS; 36 machines survive an exhaustive search, all reproduce a textbook all-pass cascade at max|err| = 0; TWO role families (A and B) survive and the numbers cannot separate them.
 (b) schroeder-topology + reverb-topology-round7 (2026-07-27): re-run in the DEVICE'S OWN ACTION/SRC vocabulary the FIRST-ORDER ALL-PASS scores ZERO and COMB families score non-zero (pipe-comb 335, series comb cascade 208 of 400 sampled from an exhaustive 82 632). The all-pass, parallel comb bank, Moorer, nested all-pass and Gray-Markel lattice are at 0 in the topology-NEUTRAL pool too.
 (c) BUT round7 sect 7.2b: every one of those survivors sits at land = -1 (the BLOCKING read), which reverb-head-tail item B FALSIFIES at the output tail 24/24 vs 0/24 on disagreement sites; in the read regime the rest of the program requires, the topology search returns ZERO of 400, all three drain conventions.
=> THE STAGE TRANSFER FUNCTION IS OPEN. Comb-family is CONSISTENT, not FORCED.
